nodes.description: Stop in tour. Parent tour: Express Tour. Description: The Quick Explorer Trail is a 1 to 2 hour, 3 km loop covering 30 plus animals, perfect for a quick visit .It passes through key zones and features big cats, primates, bears, and aquatic and reptile species.
